description: Replace keyboard punctuation with typographer's punctuation, the way Type > Smart Punctuation does: straight quotes to curly quotes, -- to an en dash and --- to an em dash, ... to an ellipsis, multiple spaces after a period to one, and optionally ff/fi/fl/ffi/ffl ligatures and fractions such as 1/2. Formatting is kept

fractions.description: Expert Fractions (turns on the font's fractions for numbers like 1/2)

ligatures.description: ff, fi, fl, ffi, ffl Ligatures (turns on the font's ligatures for those letters)

spaces.description: Smart Spaces: one space after a period

target.description: Text frames to work on (groups are searched for them). Default: every story in the document

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: apply_smart_punctuation
title: Apply Smart Punctuation
